thread:
sara: initiating region-safety wave for release v4.1.0. plan: US -> EU -> APAC, slices 15% / 25% / 60%. soft-pin + holdpoints after each region. window 22:00-23:30 UTC. ping if anything blocks. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Rollout job queued: release=v4.1.0 rollout_id=rl-20260815-410 slice=15% region=us-east-1

chris-sre: preflight summary: us-east-1 headroom ~35%, warm pool 5 nodes. set alerts: p95=300ms, 5xx-rate=0.4% sustained 5m. thermal margin ok.

oncall-sre: synthetic smoke enabled for 3m after canary. will post summary.

tom: confirming routing pin strategy: we'll flip /prod/model/current -> v4.1.0-soft at US holdpoint, then to v4.1.0 global after EU if stable.

sara: correct. also note fallback: v4.1.0-q6 is ready for APAC if headroom insufficient. ops-lead ack required to flip.

deploy-bot: Canary passed. logs: avg=130ms p95=170ms p99=290ms 5xx=0.01%

chris-sre: US holdpoint clear. proceeding to set soft-pin for US now.

deploy-bot: US slice 15% complete. metrics snapshot: p95=185ms p99=320ms 5xx=0.02%

tom: agreed rollback triggers: partial-region rollback if region 5xx >= 0.6% for >4m OR p95 > 400ms for >6m. global rollback if 2+ regions breach.

chris-sre: EU preflight: eu-central-1 headroom smaller (~22%). recommend EU initial ramp 12% for 5m then to 25%.

sara: make that change. holdpoint: require p99 < 380ms for 4m before full EU ramp.

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 12% started. rollout_id=rl-20260815-410-B

oncall-sre: EU canary saw a short p99 spike to 420ms during a synthetic burst for 15s, recovered. holding until steady.

chris-sre: EU pause in place. investigating one AZ with elevated tail latency.

tom: if it's an AZ issue we isolate that AZ and continue; use partial rollback only if isolation doesn't help.

ops-lead: isolation command: `lbctl remove-az eu-central-1b` approved.

deploy-bot: AZ isolation done. EU p99 back to 300ms. resuming ramp to 25%.

deploy-bot: EU slice 25% complete. metrics: p95=240ms p99=310ms 5xx=0.03%

sara: moving to APAC in 10m if EU holds for 15m. APAC risk: ap-southeast-1 reported degraded capacity earlier today.

oncall-sre: ap-southeast-1 headroom ~9% now. recommend APAC start with quantized fallback enabled and only promote full model if we see excess headroom.

ops-lead: ack fallback policy. command to toggle: `/ops fallback --region ap-southeast-1 --model v4.1.0-q6` (requires ops-lead + oncall).

chris-sre: APAC ramp started with mixed traffic: 70% q6 fallback, 30% full model. initial slice targeting 60% global.

deploy-bot: APAC ramp in progress. snapshot: p95_apac=220ms p99_apac=360ms 5xx_apac=0.08%

oncall-sre: thermal alert in ap-southeast-1 on 2 hosts; we shifted 30% of traffic to fallback already. watching for 5xx rate.

sara: if fallback keeps 5xx < 0.5% and p99 < 380ms we keep mixed mode. otherwise we'll throttle APAC and investigate.

chris-sre: update: fallback reduced p99 to ~280ms and 5xx to 0.03%. hosts with thermal issues are isolated and rebooted.

ops-lead: rejoining healthy nodes gradually. no rollback required.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: US=15% EU=25% APAC=60% (APAC using q6 fallback mix). final metrics global p95=200ms p99=310ms 5xx=0.04%

tom: publishing release notes & runbook links: https://internal/doc/releases/v4.1.0 and https://internal/runbooks/region-partial-rollback. file any late anomalies in #incidents.

sara: thanks all. closing thread unless anyone spots issues in next hour. :white_check_mark:
